# SelfOrthogonalizingAttractorNetworks

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Attractor neural networks that self-organize to have orthogonal memory states, reducing interference and improving recall. Enables robust associative memory in neuromorphic hardware with limited precision.
